name: FAVOR
source:
You have a shitty job at a movie theater, 'friends' that probably hate you, and a weird new acquaintance at the local pub you frequent. There is no way this can turn out badly right?....right?

Jump into the life of our main character, and meet the handsome devil Z! Z seems soft and loveable on the surface, but is that all there is to him..?

[From [url=https://concreteparasite.itch.io/favor]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在电影院有一份糟糕的工作，有可能讨厌你的“朋友”，在你经常光顾的当地酒吧里结识了一位奇怪的新朋友。这不可能会变得很糟糕吧？……对吧？

跳入主角的生活，遇见帅气的恶魔Z！Z表面上看起来温柔可爱，但这就是他的全部吗..？

[来自[url=https://concreteparasite.itch.io/favor]Itch.io[/url]]
